sloka: तथैवाप्यपरे तेषां कपीनामसिभिः शितैः।हरिवीरान्निजघ्नुश्च घोररूपा निशाचराः ।। ६.७५.६५ ।।
transliteration: tathaivāpyapare teṣāṁ kapīnāmasibhiḥ śitaiḥ।harivīrānnijaghnuśca ghorarūpā niśācarāḥ ।। 6.75.65 ।।

translations.english: In the aforesaid manner the Vanaras struck more night rangers of terrific appearance, great heroes in front of them with sharp swords.
